mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months indicates a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction and consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over six months signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% over 6 months) signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates remain low.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the CPIAUCSL growth is below 1%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong job growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased employment boosts consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 3% each over three months signals a broad-based increase in demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy accelerates.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months signals a coordinated easing of monetary and labor market conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity picks up.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
